script_text: Stop, Taurus — your Earth-sign money and mouth are under the same cosmic spotlight. The exact setup: Venus, your ruling planet, in Leo in the 4th House is trining Mars in your 1st House, while the Moon in Cancer is conjunct Jupiter in your 3rd House. Saturn in your 11th House is also squaring Uranus in your 2nd House of income, so every promise needs a paper trail. If taken, a home-based talk turns affectionate but blunt; if single, you attract someone warm, protective, and physically confident through family, a neighbor, or a voice note. In the 10th House career lane, Sun in Gemini trines Pluto in Aquarius, so a boss or client rewards precision, not flattery. Avoid co-signing a friend's plan or lending cash while Saturn squares Uranus; the unexpected gift is a paid opportunity from your network. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
